releases.notes: Scaffold: Jump Bridge (flat bridging jumps at the edge and places under you in the air at the same height, like the staircase but level); the Hypixel Preset turns it on, since Hypixel keeps jump-placed blocks and walking flat bridges broke on a coin flip; 1.0.150

Scaffold: turning mid-bridge onto a new line lets the head settle before the next click, diagonals included; a diagonal corner taken back twice in a row tries another face; steady diagonals unchanged; 1.0.149

Scaffold: right after towering or staircasing, stay on the top until the last block has stood 5 ticks, and let the head settle before the first click, diagonals included; steady diagonals unchanged; 1.0.148

Scaffold: diagonals behave exactly as in the perfect 1.0.139 run again (old turn speeds, no Turn Settle, no Ledge hold for Max Place Turn, 1.0.139 retries, Wait For Keep off in the preset); straight bridging keeps the newer changes; 1.0.147

Scaffold: Wait For Keep (bridging diagonally, don't step onto a block until it has stood 5 ticks, so a taken-back block is placed again while you're still on the last one); the Hypixel Preset turns it on; 1.0.146

Scaffold: Retry Wait (after a take-back, stay crouched this many ticks before clicking again); the Hypixel Preset waits 10, since an instant crouched retry got taken back too and led to a setback; 1.0.131
Scaffold: Eagle doesn't crouch while you hold jump, so staircasing gets no crouch on landing; 1.0.130
Scaffold: Retry Centered (a block taken back makes it crouch and try again aiming nearer the middle of the face, closer each time, until one stays); the Hypixel Preset turns it on; 1.0.129

Scaffold: Walk Back Speed (flat bridging moves at walking-backwards speed, no sprint) and Blocks To Eagle Max (Eagle crouches every random 3-5 blocks); the Hypixel Preset turns both on, with Swing Normal, Nearest Rotation and no delay, since Hypixel keeps a flat bridge that walks backwards and crouches every few blocks; 1.0.128
Scaffold: the Hypixel Preset waits 1-2 ticks at random between placements and aims at a random spot on each face, since Watchdog keeps the first 4-5 blocks and then takes back the rest; 1.0.127
Scaffold: Auto Jump switch (off = Scaffold never jumps for you: no Rescue, Head Hitter, God Bridge ledge or Telly jumps); the Hypixel Preset turns it off; 1.0.124

Scaffold: ground clicks land from both 1.8 eye heights (1.62 and 1.54) since Ledge's sneak flips can leave Hypixel tracing from the other; Rescue setting; Hypixel Preset aims at the face centre and turns Rescue off; 1.0.123
Scaffold: no rescue jump while you hold crouch; Debug lines go straight to chat with the back/kept tally first; 1.0.122

Scaffold: Max Place Turn (default 25) never clicks on a tick the aim swung further, and the Hypixel Preset turns 38-58 sideways and 26-42 up/down instead of snapping 120, since Watchdog took back blocks placed mid-snap; 1.0.121
Scaffold Debug: each taken-back block says how it was placed (ground or air, face, look, turn, reach, sneaking, which eye heights the click lands from) with a kept/taken-back tally; 1.0.120
Scaffold: only the eye height you're at has to land the click (every height is a preference), so straight bridging keeps placing after the first block; 1.0.119
Auto Fire Stop puts you out with a water bucket; Team Check on every PvP module; Legit Totem gets a gliding mouse and health checks; 1.0.114
Legit Aura: Max Drop keeps Chase from walking, strafing or jumping off drops over 4 blocks; 1.0.113
Loading a config resets modules and settings it doesn't mention instead of keeping the last config's; the loaded config's name survives a restart; 1.0.112
Sus Chunk Finder: strip mine tunnels, more placed lights, placed blocks, boxes on each find, distance and score in chat; 1.0.111
Sus Chunk Finder no longer counts cobbled deepslate; sideways deepslate stays; 1.0.110
Sus Chunk Finder no longer counts cobblestone; 1.0.109
Max Y (default 0) on Base/Farm/Kelp/Stash/Spawner Esp, Sus Chunk Finder, Better Sus Chunk, Anchor Hunter, Amethyst Bypass and Player Bypass; 1.0.108
Player Bypass ignores every change from stone; 1.0.107
Port Chunk Scanner (filled-in mine shafts) and Spawner Nametags from Anubis; 1.0.106
Anubis port: Tpahere Kill Bot (with its sell routine and tab-completion lookups); NOTICE lists every Anubis port; 1.0.95

DonutSMP features from the Anubis client (GPL-3.0, 4ldenz, https://github.com/4ldenz/Anubis-client), after checking its jar for RATs (none: no token use, no hidden classes, webhooks only to your own URL): Spawner Protect (when blocks get broken near you it mines your spawners into an ender chest, buying one from /shop if needed, then leaves; player arrivals ping a webhook), Player Detection (alert, leave, toggle modules or webhook when another player loads in; Panic Pay left out), Coord Snapper (one key copies the coords you look at or stand on), and a Donut mode for No Fall. Auto Reconnect no longer rejoins after those leave on purpose, Anti Vanish ignores your own fake players, NOTICE credits Anubis; 1.0.94

Anti Vanish built for DonutSMP: watches staff only there (Anubis's 21 Donut staff names, editable, plus tab-list staff ranks), learns whether a server sends leave messages (Donut doesn't, so a silent leave is only noted), catches vanish as hidden-from-tab or off-tab-but-body-still-here, flags staff invisible near you, probes minecraft:msg every 10s while ignoring names seen in chat (other shards), starts over on shard change, and shows a big Staff watching you title. Staff List knows the Donut staff names on Donut. Detection approach and staff names follow the Anubis client (GPL-3.0, 4ldenz); 1.0.92

Anti Vanish (Misc): says when someone switches into spectator (and how close they were), when they come out of spectator or vanish within Watch Distance of you (they were watching you; teleported to you if they'd been far off), when someone drops off the tab list without a leave message (vanished), and every Find Every seconds asks the server which names /msg tab-completes to find players online but hidden. Who's Watching lists them; 1.0.91

Auto Web Escape: when you're webbed, switches to a water bucket, flicks onto the web and pours (the water washes it away), scoops the water back up for the next web and so you're not left swimming, then back to your weapon; real switches and clicks, one a tick, Legit Aura waits meanwhile. scripts/github_release.py publishes the build as a GitHub release, which femboyware.xyz serves; 1.0.50
